description: A bright, airy primary bedroom under a cathedral vaulted ceiling clad in whitewashed or lightly bleached pine tongue-and-groove planks, the peak of the vault rising centrally and creating a strong architectural triangle. The walls below the vaulted gable are smooth white plaster. The bed is a light oak frame with a simple rectangular panel headboard, dressed in cream linen bedding with layered pillows in sandy beige and striped grey-cream cotton. A long tufted bench in light grey linen sits at the foot of the bed, its legs in light oak. To the left of the bed, a low light oak nightstand holds a small bunch of white garden roses. A large multi-pane window centered on the back wall looks out to a lush green garden with hedges and mature trees in full summer leaf, and is flanked by floor-length linen drapes in warm greige hanging from antique brass curtain rods. To the right of the window, a skirted armchair in soft dusty blue-grey upholstery sits on a light chevron-patterned area rug in grey and cream. Natural diffuse daylight fills the room warmly from the window. The overall palette is cream, warm sandy beige, bleached oak, soft greige, with a dusty blue accent chair.
